'''Blaggard Knight School''' is a [[Course]] exclusive to the [[Challenge Mode]] [[Campus]], [[The Siege of Noblestead]]. Functionally, it is largely similar to regular Knight School, and as such the player can refer to this page for information regarding Blaggard Knight School.

The main difference is the presence of [[Blaggard Knight]]s as the [[Students]] for this Course, rather than those of the the [[Knight]] Archetype introduced in [[Noblestead]]. Another important difference is that this course is of the Hard Difficulty, where regular Knight School is only Medium Difficulty. It also runs for only two years, as The Siege of Noblestead ends with the second [[Academic Year]].

Here, the Blaggard Knights will be as loyal to (and dependent upon) the player as any other Student, and will have all the same requirements. They do not seem to be especially bothered by the [[Zombies & Mummies]] wandering around, destroying the Campus - unless they render Course [[Equipment]] unusable!
